resisted: Nothing. Non-uniform ramp weights (a3, a6 ~12) give perfect ranking (AUC 1.0) with a thin margin and a miscalibrated threshold: 27/113 count-2 rows below 0.5 (train acc 0.922).
tool_bugs: Shell-quoted apply_operation JSON failed silently. Root annotate fails if subgraph_nodes include child exits.
rule_agreement: Logit peaks at exactly two first values; ranks every count-2 row above all others (AUC 1.0) but only 86/113 count-2 rows exceed 0.5: computes the rule's ordering, not its threshold.
summary: One hidden ReLU (an at-most-one-of-six gate, readout -7.61) plus a falling linear ramp (7-12 logit per first value): output = sigmoid(Ramp - 7.61 Gate - 0.93), peaking at count two. Mirrors the paper's MONK-2 construction with reversed ramp direction.
